mechanics.review: 复读原作者实战评测正文，明确七月版本改为死亡立即爆炸，失去原来的自爆动画承伤和冲锋；后续补充提到伤害增强及中期过渡作用。
索引再次读到完整分星数列；先前直开403的状态保留。本轮未取得发布方原公告或同版完整技能卡。
另一篇当日媒体报道给出相同伤害数列；不能证明来源独立，也不能将两篇转载当作发行方确证。

localAdaptations.name: 自爆
localAdaptations.damage: 采用七月11日二手历史数列200/350/500作为基础法伤，受本项目技能强度、魔抗和护盾公式影响；不再按最大生命35%计算。
localAdaptations.geometry: 沿用原型横纵距离合计2格，不宣称原版精确半径或圆形范围已证实；画面逐格轮廓与此判定一致。
localAdaptations.timing: 死亡当帧一次，无额外蓄力或冲锋；眩晕和沉默不关闭死亡被动。先标记消耗再递归，连锁中以各自死亡时阵营与伤害快照结算。
localAdaptations.targets: 已有隐形、飞行、召唤物均能被范围命中；同阵营与范围外不受伤。每个目标结算时仍须存活且属于死亡快照的敌军。
localAdaptations.growth: 确定攻击40、0.25秒离散时钟及既有二倍星级生命/普攻成长为本地模型，不冒称完整历史星级公式。
localAdaptations.animation: 鼓囊收颚喷吐及青色死亡爆发是依据轮廓和2格射程设计的本地动作，未取得原版普攻实录。

imagegen.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent isometric auto-chess unit sprite for a dark Chinese science-fantasy tactical game. Primary request: one complete Blastbug creature, faithful to the historical silhouette: a compact floating round cyan-blue gas-sac creature with a pale ivory segmented shell cupping the rear, one small sharp blue eye, broad dark teal curled horn-like mandibles encircling its face, tiny dangling pointed chin. It has no legs and no humanoid body. Three-quarter view facing lower right, elevated isometric game camera, head and swollen rounded body as one compact silhouette, all parts fully visible. Medium: polished painterly 3D game character render, sculpted readable volumes, restrained fine detail appropriate to a small game piece, matches realistic fantasy chess miniatures. Materials: soft turquoise translucent sac with subtle inner cool glow, ivory chitin plates and dark teal hard curled mandibles. Lighting: warm soft upper-left key and cool blue rim, readable on a dark board. Composition: single centered creature occupies about 82% of square canvas with generous clear padding; no base, no floor, no cast shadow, no fog, no particles, no text, no border, no watermark, no background. Actual transparent alpha background. Avoid orange abdomen, fire, beetle legs, conventional scarab, wings, weapons, multiple poses.
